none: PAS SUR-331582: Roman: Figurine of a sleeping hound
contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A small figurine (23.93mm long), probably of a hound. The animal is lying prone with his head on his forepaws (only one leg is visible). The hair on his back is parted either side of the spine and the tail is also modelled. The eyes are in the form of punched pits. The underside is flat and from its centre projects an integral rivet. This figurine was probably a mount on another metal object,…
